title: Constructibility of higher proper images of one full continuous algebraic-closure sheaf
statement: Let ell be prime, k a field of positive prime characteristic different from ell, and p:X to Y a proper k-morphism of separated finite-type k-schemes. For the condensed coefficient ring of all continuous maps into the topological algebraic closure PadicAlgCl ell, let M be a sheaf of internal modules with finite constant local models on a finite constructible stratification of X. Then every cohomology object of Rp_*(M[0]) has finite constant local models on a finite constructible stratification of Y. No bounded-complex input, cohomological bound, Tor-amplitude, coproduct or compactification assertion is made.

source.place: Assertion (1) applied to one constructible sheaf in degree zero; the sheaf-level proper finiteness input to bounded Postnikov devissage.

proof.text: Finite type over a field and quasi-compactness make X and Y Noetherian. Apply the proved generic heart_closure_generic helper in CoefficientHeartClosure, using continuousAlgCl_lf for its local finite-free hypothesis, to get kernel, cokernel and extension closure of the all-continuous finite-constant-model constructible class P on Y. The same module generic helpers and the generic proper-heart zero-model helper give isomorphism closure and zero membership. This uses the coefficient-general proved helpers, not the public coefficientHeart_closure theorem restricted to finite E and finite-subextension-valued Qbar. Therefore homologyProperty P is a replete triangulated object property; pull it back under Rp_*.

The generic proved constantModelConstructible_single helper gives bounded constant-model constructibility of M[0], with M in degree zero and rank-zero models for every other cohomology module. Apply bounded_finiteModel_generation to the inverse-image triangulated class. Its finite sheaf filtration and short-exact-sequence triangles reduce membership to generators (v_! t_* L)[0], for open v, reduced closed t, and L with a finite constant local model on S. No retract or infinite coproduct argument is needed.

An immersion into Noetherian X makes S topologically Noetherian. The generic constantModel_lfp helper in CoefficientHeartLisseRestriction turns the finite constant local model of L into local finite presentation. continuousAlgCl_lf and heart_lisse_of_free give IsLisseCoefficientModule B L. Apply continuousAlgCl_proper_lisse_stratum to this generator. The generation theorem now puts M[0] in the inverse-image class. Unpack homologyProperty to get constructibility in every integer degree. Empty strata and zero generators are included by the class closure.

proof_origin.place: Proper-image paragraph; finite stratification devissage formalized with bounded_finiteModel_generation and coefficient-general heart closure. Only the single lisse-piece calculation is split off.

theorem continuousAlgCl_proper_heart_finiteness
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p]
    (M : ConstantModelConstructible
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) X) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, IsConstantModelConstructible
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) Y
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
        ((lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M.obj)))
